name: Bastion

frame.name: Saint's Fists
frame.description:
Rapidly fires 3 spreads of pure force.

After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, reduced charge time, and improved reload speed for a short duration. Hitting a target with most of the pellets in a burst increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.description:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Breakthrough
perks.description: This weapon fires [Stagger] staggering projectiles. Strong against Unstoppable Champions.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: "The final stand is wherever I plant my feet. Not one step more." —Saint-14

catalyst.name: Bastion Catalyst
catalyst.description: Dealing melee damage increases this weapon's handling and loads a small amount of ammo from reserves.
